# Trimble Maps Single Search Geocoding API

- **Product:** Trimble Maps Single Search Geocoding API (Trimble Maps family).
- **Disposition:** `reference`. The bridge never calls this API; operations can be searched with `trimble_api_operations` and validated into a dry-run plan with `trimble_api_plan` (omit `product`).
- **Authentication:** API key, or a bearer token from POST /api/authenticate. Declared security schemes: ApiKeyAuth, BearerAuth.
- **Access:** Trimble Maps API key.
- **To call it you would need:** a Trimble Maps API key.
- **Documented servers:** `https://singlesearch.alk.com`, `https://singlesearch.az.alk.com`.
- **Definition:** [trimble-maps/single-search](https://developer.trimblemaps.com/restful-apis/api/single-search.yaml) (Trimble Maps Single Search Geocoding API, version 1.0.0). Documentation: https://developer.trimblemaps.com/restful-apis/location/single-search/single-search-api/, https://developer.trimblemaps.com/restful-apis/location/single-search/single-search-batch/.
